messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: org spike detected for org=bluehaven (qps +420% vs baseline). Multiple 429s and elevated latencies across eu-west-1. Pager routed to oncall-sre.
oncall-sre: grabbing this, oncall up. starting triage. any customer-facing alerts?
cs-notify-bot: Customer Impact: some Bluehaven users seeing request failures in the editor flow. CS paged.
alex_m: I can pull recent rate metrics and token-level traces. hitting their org quota bucket?
oncall-sre: alex, check /orgs/bluehaven/quotas and current throttle counters. Maria, you on infra?
maria_g: on it. looking at routing and backend queue depth. initial signal shows heavy small-prefix requests causing KV cache miss storm.
samir_k: If KV cache misses + bursty short requests, batching won't help. Suggest temporary org-level soft quota bump + enable per-org smoothing policy.
oncall-sre: agree. plan: 1) apply emergency quota +20% for org bluehaven 2) enable smoothing policy (window=60s) 3) monitor 5m, then decide. executing now.
alex_m: running check: `GET /admin/orgs/bluehaven/usage` -> current qps=3.8k, quota=4k, error rate=6.7%.
oncall-sre: applying hotfix: `POST /admin/orgs/bluehaven/quota?action=override&delta=+800 --headers 'X-Run-By:oncall-sre'`
maria_g: applied override, backend returned 200. new quota=4800.
samir_k: enabling smoothing: `PATCH /runtime/policies/smoothing?org=bluehaven&window=60&strategy=leaky` -> deployed to eu-west-1 canaries.
alex_m: can see immediate drop in 429s from 6.7% -> 1.2% in the canary shard. latency tail also improved ~120ms -> ~80ms p95.
oncall-sre: rolling to all shards in eu-west-1 now. keeping global routing intact.
cs-notify-bot: CS update: Notifying account team + customer success. We told customer "temporary quota bump and smoothing enabled, we're monitoring".
maria_g: added brief firewall rule to prevent abusive IPs that showed up in the trace (two IP ranges). minimal drop in throughput.
samir_k: note: this is a mitigation not root cause. KV cache warming and addressing small-prefix pattern needed. setting a follow-up action item.
oncall-sre: incident timeline so far: alarm at 6321117700, page 6321117777, quota hotfix 6321117890, smoothing rollout 6321117960.
alex_m: creating eval to reproduce small-prefix storm locally. will open a PR with a synthetic load test and recommended model prompt batching changes.
cs-notify-bot: Customer message prepared: "We observed a transient spike causing elevated errors. We applied a temporary quota increase and a smoothing policy; please expect improved stability. We'll share a post-incident with root cause and permanent fix ETA".
oncall-sre: monitoring window green for 10m, error rate steady ~0.9%. keeping this thread open for 30m then will revert overrides if stable.
maria_g: scheduling a canary-to-prod revert plan: `POST /admin/orgs/bluehaven/quota?action=revert --at=6321119960` (tentative).
samir_k: follow-ups: 1) KV cache tuning + prefix caching for their workload 2) evaluate request shaping on client SDK 3) postmortem + RFC for org-surge playbook.
oncall-sre: thanks team. thumbs if understood. :thumbsup:
alex_m: :thumbsup:
maria_g: :thumbsup:
samir_k: :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE [resolved?monitoring] org=bluehaven mitigation applied. oncall: oncall-sre. Please update ticket ID INC-2026-834 and mark follow-ups.
oncall-sre: closing active mitigation steps. will keep observing; create postmortem draft after 24h of stable metrics.
cs-notify-bot: Sent customer follow-up note and flagged for account review.
oncall-sre: end of thread for now. will repost if any regressions.
